subs.note: Nicolas de Marle. The movements of the mass, each on its own.

items.title: Kyrie (de Marle, Missa O gente brunette)
items.desc: Nicolas de Marle, Missa O gente brunette, Kyrie, 1568. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
